summary: Short wholesaler visit in Lucknow. The rep booked an order of Maggi 40 cartons and Parle-G 15 cartons. The customer said Mom's Magic is slow because the ₹30 pack is too expensive for villages, asked for a ₹10 pack, said Patanjali gives retailers higher margins, said retailers need at least 15% margin, and said the current scheme is too complicated. The rep agreed to pass this feedback to the area manager.
score_reason: A solid order was taken and useful competitor and slow-mover intel was captured, but there was no visibility check, no dues discussion and no clear explanation of the current scheme.

coaching.tip: Asking which stock was stuck brought out the Mom's Magic pricing problem and the ₹10 pack idea. That is excellent field intel, so keep asking about slow movers on every visit.
When the customer said the scheme was confusing, explain the current scheme yourself with a simple worked example. Also cover display, shelf share and pending dues before closing the visit.
When Patanjali's margins come up, capture specifics: the exact margin percentage, which SKUs and which retailers. This gives the area manager concrete numbers to act on.

debrief: रवि, अग्रवाल ट्रेडर्स की विज़िट अच्छी रही। मैगी चालीस कार्टन और पारले-जी पंद्रह कार्टन का ऑर्डर मिला। बहुत बढ़िया कि आपने पूछा कौन सा माल रुका हुआ है। इससे मॉम्स मैजिक के दाम और पतंजलि के मार्जिन की असली जानकारी मिली। अगली बार शेल्फ़ और डिस्प्ले भी देखिए, बकाया भुगतान की बात कीजिए, और मौजूदा स्कीम खुद आसान शब्दों में समझाइए। अब दस रुपये वाले पैक और पंद्रह प्रतिशत मार्जिन की बात एरिया मैनेजर तक पहुँचाइए।
